pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Represent COSA, an unspecified thing, as a learned AAC symbol: three different complete everyday small objects side by side on white: a spoon, a plain wooden cube and a key. Only the wooden cube in the center is surrounded by a simple RED oval, with one red arrow pointing to that selected object. Other two objects neutral gray with less contrast. Emphasize one unspecified object selected among different things, not a category label. No numbers, letters or writing. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.

alt.ca: Un objecte encerclat i assenyalat entre una cullera i una clau representa una cosa seleccionada.
alt.es: Un objeto rodeado y señalado entre una cuchara y una llave representa una cosa seleccionada.
